name: KUB-1

image.caption: No open-licensed photograph found for this specific system — showing its category symbol.

characteristics: Strength: Compact and simple, giving a lower-cost alternative to the larger Lancet for smaller targets
Limitation: Smaller warhead and shorter range than Lancet, limiting it to lighter targets
Estimated quantity available: Fleet size not disclosed
employment_notes: Represents the lower end of Russia's loitering-munition tier, illustrating a deliberate range of munition sizes matched to target value rather than a one-size-fits-all approach
contrast_vs_traditional: A small loitering munition brings the same squad/company-level precision-strike capability doctrine.md documents for Switchblade to the Russian side of the line — a further data point for the finding that distributed, organic strike capability at low echelon, not centralized fires, increasingly does this kind of engagement on both sides.

sources.label: Army Recognition — Russia confirms deployment of KUB loitering munition

notes: Specs meet the bar but the unit cost is an estimate — cost is not verified.
